ashley: Quick async: status on console obs roadmap? specifically dashboards for infra errors, tracing hooks for model-serving routes, and retention milestone for traces. Need owners and blockers by EOD. @ben @david @sophia
ben: Right now dash basics done. Waiting on final schema from @david. I can own dashboard wiring.
david: Schema PR is open: https://git.internal/redwood/obs-schema/pull/58. Need review from eng-platform and obs-telemetry. Blocker: index size on traces -> retention tradeoff.
sophia: Working on tracing hook PR; tests flaky in staging. Pinged infra for env var issue. ETA tomorrow.
carla: FYI on retention: Legal wants 90 days for traces for compliance but product asks 30. Proposed config to support per-tenant retention. See snippet:
```yaml
tracing:
  default_retention_days: 30
  max_retention_days: 90
  per_tenant: true
```
ben: :thumbsup: per-tenant makes sense. If we do that, need UI control and billing flag.
ashley: Ownership call: @ben owns dashboards, @david owns schema + storage change, @sophia owns tracing hooks, @carla handles retention policy + compliance. Is everyone okay?
david: OK from storage side but need a migration window. Will coordinate with eng-infra for low-traffic window. Tentative weekend.
sophia: OK but need help with flaky tests — @tj can you help debug the staging race?
tj: I can look today, probably the env var TTL race. Will post findings.

ben: I'll review tonight. :eyes:
